Tasty food, but we felt ripped off on the price.
Feb 2026 • Friends
We ordered two Chicken Butter combos with cheese naan (279K VND each) and two Dal Makhani (189K VND each). The Dal Makhani came with butter naan and each combo included two small cheese naans. Up to that point, everything was delicious and we were enjoying the meal.
We then ordered three extra plain butter naans. However, when it was time to pay, we were charged 600K VND for these simple naan breads. The prices were not listed on the menu but the amount was completely out of proportion compared to the prices of the main dishes.
When we asked if a mistake had been made, the staff acted as if they didn’t understand us. Only when we mentioned that we would write a review they suddenly become willing to discuss it. By then, we had lost interest in arguing, paid the full amount, and decided never to return. (prices ex 8% + 5%)
